temp_max.label: Highest temperature
temp_max.note: Highest single daily maximum at any one station.

temp_min.label: Lowest temperature
temp_min.note: Lowest single daily minimum at any one station.

rain_daily.label: Rainfall, heaviest day
rain_daily.note: Largest single station-day total in the window.

rain_total.label: Rainfall, event total
rain_total.note: Summed across the window at the wettest single station, never added across stations.

snow_daily.label: Snowfall, heaviest day
snow_daily.note: Largest single station-day total in the window.

snow_total.label: Snowfall, event total
snow_total.note: Summed across the window at the snowiest single station, never added across stations.

wind_2min.label: Fastest two-minute wind
wind_2min.note: GHCN element WSF2, a two-minute mean. Not a gust: these stations do not report peak gust.

surge_peak.label: Peak storm surge, derived
surge_peak.note: Observed water level minus predicted tide at The Battery. Derived here, not published.

tide_peak.label: Peak water level
tide_peak.note: Highest observed reading at The Battery on the MLLW datum. Coastal events only.

deaths.label: Deaths, direct
deaths.note: Weather Service count. Indirect deaths are counted separately and never added to this.

injuries.label: Injuries, direct
injuries.note: Weather Service count for this event's records.

damage_property.label: Property damage, as published
damage_property.note: Weather Service estimate, summed over this event's records. Nominal dollars.

fema_pa.label: Public assistance to the declaration
fema_pa.note: Federal share obligated to the disaster declarations covering this event, for New York City counties. It belongs to the declaration, not to the storm.

fema_ia.label: Housing assistance to the declaration
fema_ia.note: Individuals and Households Program approved to those declarations, owners and renters, New York City ZIP codes. Belongs to the declaration.

nfip_paid.label: Flood insurance paid
nfip_paid.note: Claims joined by date of loss inside the window, so they exist for undeclared events too.

complaints_311.label: 311 complaints, no heat or hot water
complaints_311.note: Resident-reported requests in the window and the day after. Measures reporting as well as impact.

complaints_flooding.label: 311 complaints, street and sewer flooding
complaints_flooding.note: Resident-reported requests in the window and the day after.

complaints_trees.label: 311 complaints, tree emergencies
complaints_trees.note: Resident-reported requests in the window and the day after.

collisions.label: Vehicle collisions
collisions.note: Police-reported collisions inside the event window, with no following day.

ncei-storm-events.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
ncei-storm-events.name: Storm Events Database
ncei-storm-events.grain: One row per event type, per place, per time window
ncei-storm-events.coverage: 1950 to present. All event types only from 1996.
ncei-storm-events.caveat: Before 1996 only tornado, hail and wind were recorded, so counts before that year measure what was collected as much as what happened.

hurdat2.name: HURDAT2 Atlantic best track
hurdat2.grain: One row per storm per six-hour synoptic time
hurdat2.caveat: Best track is a post-season reanalysis, not live observation.

ghcn-daily.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
ghcn-daily.name: Global Historical Climatology Network, daily
ghcn-daily.grain: One row per station per day
ghcn-daily.caveat: Daily summaries, not hourly. Rainfall rate and heat index cannot be derived from them and are not offered.

coops.publisher: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
coops.name: Tides and Currents water levels
coops.grain: One reading per station per six minutes
coops.caveat: Surge is observed water level minus predicted tide. It is derived by this project, not published as such.

iem-radar.publisher: Iowa State University, Iowa Environmental Mesonet
iem-radar.name: NEXRAD composite reflectivity tile archive
iem-radar.grain: One raster tile per five-minute step
iem-radar.caveat: A national composite, not a single-radar product. Tiles are read live from the archive rather than copied.

fema-pa.name: Public Assistance Funded Projects Details, v2
fema-pa.caveat: Obligations continue for years after an event, so a total is only true as at the snapshot date.

fema-ia-owners.name: Housing Assistance Program Data, Owners, v2
fema-ia-owners.grain: One row per disaster per ZIP code
fema-ia-owners.caveat: Owners and renters are separate populations and are not summed.

fema-ia-renters.name: Housing Assistance Program Data, Renters, v2
fema-ia-renters.grain: One row per disaster per ZIP code
fema-ia-renters.caveat: Owners and renters are separate populations and are not summed.

fema-nfip.name: NFIP Redacted Claims, v3
fema-nfip.caveat: Claims join to an event by date of loss, not by declaration, so they exist for undeclared events too. v2 is deprecated from 15 October 2026.

fema-declarations.name: Disaster Declarations Summaries, v2
fema-declarations.grain: One row per disaster per county

nyc-311.name: 311 Service Requests
nyc-311.caveat: Resident-reported, so it measures reporting as well as impact. Complaint vocabularies change across the dataset splits.

nyc-collisions.name: Motor Vehicle Collisions, Crashes
nyc-collisions.caveat: Nothing before July 2012. That is not applicable, not zero.

bls-cpi.name: CPI-U, New York-Newark-Jersey City, all items
bls-cpi.caveat: A metropolitan index. Deflating New York losses by the national index would understate them.

radar.attribution: Radar imagery: Iowa Environmental Mesonet, Iowa State University

fema-nfip.label: the event window and the following day, by date of loss
